messages.text: Hi, I sent the USB charger back, it stopped working after a day. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Refund for returned USB wall charger that stopped working after one day; eligibility and required steps"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
